articleTitle: Why Ramping Up Marathon Training Can Make You Wired at Bedtime
imageHeadline: Training harder but sleeping worse? Here's why.
imageSubtext: What marathon training does to your nervous system at night.
pinTitle: Why Marathon Training Disrupts Sleep (And How to Wind Down After Hard Workouts)
pinDescription: Ramping up your running volume can leave you wired at bedtime. Learn what's happening in your nervous system when training load increases, and evidence-based strategies to help your body wind down after hard training days.
